podcast.body: This duet cover, featured on Parsons' "Grievous Angel" album, is described as an intensely emotional interpretation of the song, combining heartbreak, desperation, beauty, love, and sorrow. It is cited as a definitive version, surpassing earlier renditions by The Everly Brothers and Roy Orbison, and the later Nazareth cover. "It is all together. Heart breaking and desperate and beautiful and loving and sorrowful. Love Hurts, no strong enough to take a lot of pain."
